heading: Is AirPal.Me legit?
summary: AirPal.Me is a guest-companion and local-discovery platform built in Sydney by SarvamDaily Pty Ltd (ABN 83 702 462 977). It is not Arjo's AirPal mattress or the airpal.app flight tool — company facts, verification links and an honest early-access status.

jsonLd.disambiguatingDescription: AirPal.Me is a Sydney-built guest-companion and local-discovery platform operated by SarvamDaily Pty Ltd. It is not Arjo's AirPal patient-transfer mattress, the airpal.app flight-search tool, or any other AirPal-named app.

acceptedAnswer.text: AirPal.Me is built with email and phone verification, understandable reputation, reporting and blocking, human admin review of safety cases, and payments held inside the platform — but no marketplace where people meet in real life can guarantee personal safety. Meet in public places, keep chat and payment inside AirPal.Me, and read the safety guidance in our help center.

AirPal.Me is operated by SarvamDaily Pty Ltd (ABN 83 702 462 977), trading as AirPal.Me, in New South Wales, Australia. You can check the ABN Lookup record yourself — the link is at the bottom of this page.

mainEntity.name: Is AirPal.Me the same as AirPal mattresses?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Arjo's AirPal is a medical patient-transfer mattress made by Arjo. AirPal.Me has no affiliation with Arjo, with the airpal.app flight-search tool, or with any other AirPal-named app.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to download an app?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Guests can browse places, stays, plans and events on the airpal.me website without an account. Native iOS and Android apps exist for members who want them; they require sign-in.
